svg.title: One USB. The whole slider.
svg.desc: Top-view breadboard assembly drawing. Refer to the generated wiring table and validation report.
svg.text: USB powers the dongle. Its VBUS pad feeds the motor driver.
Crossings without dots do not join.
Upper U: TB6612 in C10-C15 / G8-G17.
VM end down; offset motor-power pads stay empty.
Lower L: Nordic in C8-C17 / G8-G17; USB down.
Rows restart at 1 on each mini. No power rails.
Keeps the motor off while the MCU pin floats.
Confirm the pot tabs with a meter; leave T open.
5 V goes out through VBUS to VMotor.
No second supply; USB data still works.
Meter VBUS about 5 V; VCC at least 2.7 V.
Boot with STBY low; hand-sweep the ADC.
Then test one 20 ms pulse at mid-travel.
Verify startup/stall demand and VM under load.
The 5 V connection is checked; motor current
and actual breadboard fit need bench checks.
Header-aware connectivity checked / hardware bring-up still required
Editable circuit data + reusable part definitions + renderer / sources and bench notes in README
